# Introduction

Figure S10A: PCA for NanoString gene expression under different stimulation
conditions (Null, Mtb_Ag, LPS, IL1B) at W0 and W16 in the treatment success
group.

Figure S10B: Volcano plots for differentially expressed NanoString genes
(paired Wilcoxon test, FDR-adjusted) between W0 and W16 under each stimulation
condition. Log2 fold change is computed as median(W16) − median(W0) on
log2-normalised data.

# Load packages

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(FactoMineR)
library(factoextra)
library(writexl)
```

# Define file paths

```{r}
#| label: file-paths

input_nano      <- "Input/Nanostring_Wide_log2_normalised.xlsx"
output_main     <- "Output/Figure_S10"
output_pca      <- file.path(output_main, "PCA")
output_volcano  <- file.path(output_main, "Volcano")
output_wilcoxon <- file.path(output_main, "Wilcoxon")

for (d in c(output_main, output_pca, output_volcano, output_wilcoxon)) {
```

# Load data

```{r}
#| label: load-data

all_data <- read_excel(input_nano, sheet = 1) %>%
  filter(Comments == "success") %>%
  mutate(
    Stimulation = ifelse(Stimulation == "TB",   "Mtb_Ag", Stimulation),
    Stimulation = ifelse(Stimulation == "NULL", "Null",   Stimulation),
    Visit       = paste0("W", Visit),
    Stimulation = factor(Stimulation, levels = c("Null", "Mtb_Ag", "LPS", "IL1B"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!Barcode %in% "0408230288") %>%
  select(-Barcode)

# Show first 8 columns only to avoid wide output
head(all_data[, 1:8])
dim(all_data)
```

# Define metadata and gene columns

```{r}
#| label: define-columns
id_col    <- "Donor"

meta_cols <- c(id_col, "Visit", "Stimulation")
gene_cols <- all_data %>%
  select(ACE:TBP) %>%
  names()

cat(sprintf("Metadata columns : %s\n", paste(meta_cols, collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("Gene columns     : %d\n", length(gene_cols)))
cat(sprintf("First 5 genes    : %s\n", paste(head(gene_cols, 5), collapse = ", ")))
```

# Variance filtering

```{r}
#| label: variance-filter

variance_threshold <- 0.1

gene_vars   <- sapply(gene_cols, function(g) var(all_data[[g]], na.rm = TRUE))
valid_genes <- gene_cols[!is.na(gene_vars) & gene_vars > variance_threshold]

cat(sprintf(
  "Genes with NA variance (all values missing): %d\n",
  sum(is.na(gene_vars))
))
cat(sprintf(
  "Genes with zero/low variance (< %.2f): %d\n",
  variance_threshold,
  sum(!is.na(gene_vars) & gene_vars <= variance_threshold)
))
cat(sprintf(
  "Genes retained: %d / %d\n",
  length(valid_genes), length(gene_cols)
))

selected_data <- all_data %>%
  select(all_of(c(meta_cols, valid_genes)))
```

# PCA function

```{r}
#| label: pca-function

run_pca <- function(data, visit, meta_cols) {

  dat <- data %>%
    filter(Visit == visit) %>%
    as.data.frame()

  cat(sprintf("\nPCA at %s: %d rows x %d columns\n",
              visit, nrow(dat), ncol(dat)))

  quali_idx <- which(names(dat) %in% meta_cols)

  tryCatch({
    PCA(dat, scale. = TRUE, graph = FALSE, quali.sup = quali_idx)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(sprintf("PCA failed at %s: %s", visit, e$message))
    NULL
  })
}
```

# Run PCA for both visits

```{r}
#| label: run-pca
#| message: false
#| warning: false

dat_w0 <- selected_data %>%
  filter(Visit == "W0") %>%
  as.data.frame()

dat_w16 <- selected_data %>%
  filter(Visit == "W16") %>%
  as.data.frame()

pca_w0  <- run_pca(selected_data, visit = "W0",  meta_cols = meta_cols)
pca_w16 <- run_pca(selected_data, visit = "W16", meta_cols = meta_cols)

cat("Variance explained W0:\n")
print(round(get_eig(pca_w0)[1:4, ], 2))

cat("Variance explained W16:\n")
print(round(get_eig(pca_w16)[1:4, ], 2))
```

# Paired Wilcoxon function

```{r}
#| label: wilcoxon-function
#| message: true

compare_w0_w16 <- function(data, condition, id_col, gene_cols,
                            w0_code = "W0", w16_code = "W16") {

  dat <- data %>% filter(Stimulation == condition)

  # Check for duplicates
  dup_check  <- table(paste(dat[[id_col]], dat$Visit, sep = "_"))
  duplicates <- names(dup_check[dup_check > 1])
  if (length(duplicates) > 0) {
    message(sprintf(
      "WARNING [%s]: duplicate ID-Visit combinations found: %s",
      condition, paste(duplicates, collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }

  patients_w0   <- unique(dat[[id_col]][dat$Visit == w0_code])
  patients_w16  <- unique(dat[[id_col]][dat$Visit == w16_code])
  patients_both <- intersect(patients_w0, patients_w16)

  cat(sprintf("\n[%s] Participants with both %s and %s: %d\n",
              condition, w0_code, w16_code, length(patients_both)))

  if (length(patients_both) == 0) {
    message(sprintf("[%s] No paired participants found — skipping.", condition))
    return(data.frame())
  }

  result_list <- lapply(gene_cols, function(gene) {

    w0_vals  <- c()
    w16_vals <- c()

    for (pid in patients_both) {
      r0  <- which(dat[[id_col]] == pid & dat$Visit == w0_code)[1]
      r16 <- which(dat[[id_col]] == pid & dat$Visit == w16_code)[1]

      if (!is.na(r0) && !is.na(r16)) {
        v0  <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(dat[r0,  gene])))
        v16 <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(dat[r16, gene])))
        if (!is.na(v0) && !is.na(v16)) {
          w0_vals  <- c(w0_vals,  v0)
          w16_vals <- c(w16_vals, v16)
        }
      }
    }

    if (length(w0_vals) < 5) return(NULL)

    diffs <- w16_vals - w0_vals
    if (var(diffs) == 0) return(NULL)

    tryCatch({
      test   <- wilcox.test(w0_vals, w16_vals, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)
      log2fc <- median(w16_vals) - median(w0_vals)

      data.frame(
        analyte          = gene,
        p_value          = test$p.value,
        p_adjusted       = NA_real_,
        median_W0        = median(w0_vals),
        median_W16       = median(w16_vals),
        log2_fold_change = log2fc,
        fold_change      = 2^log2fc,
        n_pairs          = length(w0_vals)
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      message(sprintf("Wilcoxon error [%s | %s]: %s", condition, gene, e$message))
      NULL
    })
  })

  results <- bind_rows(result_list)

  if (nrow(results) == 0) {
    message(sprintf("[%s] No genes returned results.", condition))
    return(results)
  }

  # FDR adjustment using Benjamini-Hochberg
  results <- results %>%
    mutate(
      p_adjusted   = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
      significance = case_when(
        p_adjusted < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_adjusted < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p_adjusted < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE               ~ ""
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(p_adjusted)

  cat(sprintf("[%s] Genes tested: %d | Significant (FDR < 0.05): %d\n",
              condition,
              nrow(results),
              sum(results$p_adjusted < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)))

  results
}
```

# Volcano plot function

```{r}
#| label: volcano-function

create_volcano_plot <- function(results_df, reference_group, comparison_group,
                                 log2fc_threshold = 1,
                                 p_threshold      = 0.05,
                                 max_labels       = 200) {

  volcano_data <- results_df %>%
    mutate(
      log10p       = -log10(p_adjusted),
      significance = case_when(
        is.na(p_adjusted)                                 ~ "Not Tested",
        p_adjusted >= p_threshold                         ~ "Not Significant",
        p_adjusted <  p_threshold & log2_fold_change > 0 ~ "Positive",
        p_adjusted <  p_threshold & log2_fold_change < 0 ~ "Negative"
      ),
      significance = factor(significance,
                            levels = c("Positive", "Negative",
                                       "Not Significant", "Not Tested")),
      to_label     = !is.na(p_adjusted) &
        p_adjusted < p_threshold &
        abs(log2_fold_change) > log2fc_threshold
    )

  label_analytes <- volcano_data %>%
    filter(to_label) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(log2_fold_change) * log10p)) %>%
    head(max_labels) %>%
    pull(analyte)

  volcano_data <- volcano_data %>%
    mutate(label = ifelse(analyte %in% label_analytes, analyte, ""))

  ggplot(volcano_data,
         aes(x = log2_fold_change, y = log10p, color = significance)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(p_threshold),
      linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50"
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = c(-log2fc_threshold, log2fc_threshold),
      linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50"
    ) +
    geom_text_repel(
      aes(label = label),
      max.overlaps  = 40,
      box.padding   = 0.5,
      segment.color = "gray50",
      force         = 3,
      size          = 3
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Positive"        = "red",
        "Negative"        = "blue",
        "Not Significant" = "gray70",
        "Not Tested"      = "gray70"
      ),
      breaks = c("Positive", "Negative", "Not Significant", "Not Tested")
    ) +
    labs(
      title    = paste0(reference_group, " vs ", comparison_group),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Positive: higher in ", comparison_group,
        " | Negative: higher in ", reference_group
      ),
      x     = "Log2 Fold Change (W16 / W0)",
      y     = "-Log10 FDR-adjusted p-value",
      color = "Significance"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text        = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.title       = element_text(color = "black"),
      legend.position  = "right",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(shape = 16, size = 4, alpha = 1)
    ))
}
```

# Figure S10B — Wilcoxon tests and volcano plots for all conditions

```{r}
#| label: run-wilcoxon-volcano
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8
#| message: true
#| warning: false

conditions  <- c("Null", "Mtb_Ag", "LPS", "IL1B")
all_results <- list()

for (cond in conditions) {

  results <- compare_w0_w16(
    data      = selected_data,
    condition = cond,
    id_col    = id_col,          # defined in define-columns chunk
    gene_cols = valid_genes
  )

  all_results[[cond]] <- results

  if (nrow(results) == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("[%s] No results — skipping plot.\n", cond))
    next
  }

  # Save per-condition results
  write_xlsx(
    results,
    path = file.path(output_wilcoxon,
                     paste0("S10B_", cond, "_W0_W16_wilcoxon.xlsx"))
  )

  # Create volcano plot
  volcano <- create_volcano_plot(
    results_df       = results,
    reference_group  = paste0(cond, "_W0"),
    comparison_group = paste0(cond, "_W16"),
    log2fc_threshold = 1,
    p_threshold      = 0.05,
    max_labels       = 200
  )

  print(volcano)

  ggsave(
    file.path(output_volcano,
              paste0("S10B_", cond, "_W0_W16_volcano.png")),
    plot   = volcano,
    width  = 10,
    height = 8,
    dpi    = 300
  )
}

# Save all conditions in one workbook — one sheet per condition
write_xlsx(
  all_results,
  path = file.path(output_wilcoxon, "S10B_all_conditions_wilcoxon_results.xlsx")
)

cat("\nAll outputs saved to:", output_main, "\n")
```
